predecessor.disposition: preserved immutable short diagnostic; not reused as long-window measurement or criteria

runtime.threads: auto; record observed Julia thread count
runtime.observed_line: CANDIDATE_C_LONG_CPU_RUNTIME julia=<VERSION> waterlily=<pkgversion> threads=<positive observed count> backend=Array precision=Float32 source_sha256=<job_sha256> manifest_sha256=<source_manifest_sha256>
runtime.version_gate: before any Simulation construction, require Julia 1.12.6 and WaterLily 1.8.0 exactly
runtime.thread_count: record Threads.nthreads() observed for geometry/preflight/formal process; do not gate exact count

operator.mu1: raw WaterLily mu1 and wrapped body normal; unchanged
operator.solver_body_composition: CandidateCWaterLilyBody(normal_floor_candidate, moving_ground) is the outer simulation.body so Candidate C measure! dispatch is reached
operator.candidate_force_body: Candidate C normal-floor candidate only; moving ground is excluded to match W3/W4 force integration

canonical_grid_sdf.construction: sample exact analytic SDF at every grid node; negative inside

fixtures.description: long rectangular solid, 0.5 m streamwise by 0.05 m transverse thickness by 0.5 m height; one flow-cell thickness
same long solid with 0.10 m transverse thickness; two flow-cell thickness

fixtures.candidate_force_scope: NoBody; exact zero candidate-force reference, report-only

arms.native: native analytic AutoBody or NoBody with the same registered moving ground
arms.grid_upstream: same sampled Float32 GridSDF through NormalFloorWaterLilyBody(normal_floor=0.25), upstream WaterLily moment path, and same moving ground
arms.candidate_c: same sampled Float32 GridSDF through NormalFloorWaterLilyBody(normal_floor=0.25) and outer CandidateCWaterLilyBody around candidate-plus-moving-ground union
arms.force_attribution: for every arm, report candidate-only, ground-only, and actual combined solver-body pressure/viscous/total forces separately in N; candidate-only is the W3/W4 target metric
arms.comparisons: native versus GridSDF-upstream includes sampling/normal-floor differences; GridSDF-upstream versus Candidate C isolates the moment blend; all comparisons descriptive, no accuracy threshold

measurement.force_units: body-on-fluid reaction negated once; physical forces in N
measurement.external_face_indices: normal faces x=2/nx,y=2/ny,z=2/nz; transverse indices 2:n-1 exclude ghost layers
measurement.domain_divergence: sum Float64(u_high)-Float64(u_low) over WaterLily inside(p), then multiply rho*U*h^2; cast operands before subtraction
measurement.window_statistic: endpoint-interpolated trapezoid from raw flushed samples on [5,7.5], [7.5,10], and [5,10]
measurement.force_closure: candidate-only pressure + viscous = total in N; identical arithmetic integrity checks are recorded for ground and combined groups
measurement.mass_interpretation: whole-domain external flux and divergence are integrity diagnostics, not immersed-body mass conservation
measurement.wall_velocity: record declared moving-ground velocity and z-face normal flow; the nearby differently staggered streamwise velocity is report-only and is not a wall-slip measurement; no numeric no-penetration threshold
measurement.native_vs_gridsdf: report force differences only; no numerical accuracy threshold
measurement.empty_grid: moving_ground_only is an all-positive field with no zero level; phi_margin_m=NA and phi_has_zero_level=false
measurement.raw_force: persist raw WaterLily pressure/viscous body-on-fluid solver vectors separately from physical body-force SI columns; verify physical_N = -raw_solver*0.0025 exactly once

registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D1_source_identity: criteria, host runner, Julia job, package files, Candidate C body, NormalFloor body, and pinned historical body match exact SHA-256 inventory before simulation setup
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D2_fixture_identity: all four registered analytic fixtures sampled on exact Float32 grid; moving_ground_only records empty-interface status and NA margin; active fixtures use inherited GridSDF constructor 1e-6 m arithmetic slack at the unchanged nominal 0.15 m margin; every grid hash recorded
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D3_completion: all twelve fixture/arm integrations reach at least 10 tU/L and preserve raw flushed histories
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D4_field_finiteness: velocity, pressure, force, external-face flux and divergence diagnostic values are finite at every raw sample
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D5_exact_windows: host independently recomputes endpoint-interpolated trapezoid means from the raw CSV; missing brackets fail closed
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D6_force_arithmetic: persist raw WaterLily body-on-fluid pressure/viscous vectors and physical SI body-force components separately; independently verify one sign flip and scale, then pressure plus viscous equals total for candidate-only, ground-only and combined-body groups
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D7_domain_flux_arithmetic: six signed external-face fluxes sum to net outward flow and Float64-before-subtraction integrated divergence minus net flow reproduces the recorded domain residual
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D8_moving_ground_identity: body velocity is (+1,0,0), equals registered freestream, and has zero normal component; normal flow at z face and differently staggered nearby streamwise component are separately described as raw diagnostics, with no slip acceptance
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D9_grid_margin: active sampled GridSDFs use the existing constructor margin check at nominal 0.15 m with its existing 1e-6 m absolute arithmetic tolerance; no-interface all-positive fixture has explicit NA margin
registered_diagnostic_integrity_checks.D10_runtime_identity: record exactly one parsed Julia runtime line in geometry/init preflight and formal result; exact Julia/WaterLily versions, Array CPU backend, Float32 precision, positive observed thread count, and exact job/source-manifest SHA bindings required before proceeding

unresolved_physical_contracts.mass_acceptance: UNRESOLVED: no accepted fluid control-volume definition including immersed-boundary contribution, uncertainty model, or justified mass-balance acceptance threshold exists. Whole-domain flux-divergence telescoping is not mass-conservation qualification.
unresolved_physical_contracts.no_penetration_acceptance: UNRESOLVED: record wall-normal flow at the registered moving boundary face, but no physics-based tolerance is preregistered.
unresolved_physical_contracts.native_accuracy: UNRESOLVED: report native-versus-sampled force differences; no accuracy threshold is justified from Round 5 or this data.
unresolved_physical_contracts.stationarity: UNRESOLVED: [5,7.5] and [7.5,10] means/drift are descriptive only; no stationarity threshold or PASS is registered.

Candidate C production-operator qualification or W3-C/W4-C qualification
